eyebrow.zh: 少打断 · 会学习 · 本地优先 · 全 agent
eyebrow.en: Fewer interrupts · Learns · Local-first · Every agent

headline.zh:
你的 agent
不再每一步都打断你
headline.en:
Your agent
stops interrupting you every step

sub.zh: 从你过去标注的决策里学会哪些操作可以安全放行，只在真正陌生的风险上才找你——并把同一份学会的信任带进你用的每一个编码 agent。
sub.en: Learns from your past labels which actions are safe to auto-approve, only escalates on genuinely novel risk, and carries that same learned trust into every coding agent you use.

title.zh: 第 50 次 npm install，不再问你
title.en: The 50th npm install, no longer asks

body.zh: 从你的历史标签学会熟悉动作可以安全放行；重复的工具调用自动批准，而且你能用一条命令看见它学会了。
body.en: Learns from your history that familiar actions are safe to auto-approve; repetitive calls flow through on their own — and one command shows you it learned.

chips: › git status / npm install / pytest 预标安全

title.zh: 只在真正陌生的风险上找你
title.en: Only escalates on genuinely novel risk

body.zh: 没见过的动作——curl 未知主机再管道给 bash——才上报人工；破坏性命令无论怎么写都照常上报，绝不自动放行。
body.en: Unseen actions — like curl to an unknown host piped to bash — escalate to you; destructive commands escalate no matter how they're written, never auto-approved.

chips: › 破坏性命令怎么写都照常上报
› 熟悉 = 放行，陌生 = 找你

title.zh: 同一份信任，带进每个 agent
title.en: One learned trust, across every agent

body.zh: Cursor、Aider、Claude Code 共享同一份学会的信任——你在哪个工具里积累的标签，都跟着你走。
body.en: Cursor, Aider, and Claude Code share one learned trust — the labels you build in any tool follow you across all of them.

chips: › Cursor / Aider / Claude Code 一处学会
› 任何 agent 都能查风险分级

title.zh: 本地一个文件，数据不出境
title.en: One local file, data never leaves

body.zh: 一个进程、一个本地文件、无后台服务。所有标签留在你机器里——这正是企业自托管买家要的那条保证。
body.en: One process, one local file, no backend service. Every label stays on your machine — the guarantee enterprise self-host buyers pay for.

headline.zh: 让 agent 学会你信任什么
headline.en: Let your agent learn what you trust

sub.zh: uvx 即装，本地运行，MIT 开源。
sub.en: uvx install, runs locally, MIT open source.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 本地优先 · 全 agent
tag.en: MIT open source · local-first · every agent
